bar.no_value_hint: The mouse may be off or asleep, or the receiver passes nothing on. Replugging the receiver often helps.

notify.critical_body: {name} is down to {level}%. Charge it now.

panel.hint_mouse_off: No current battery level (mouse off or asleep).
panel.none: No Keychron mouse found. Receiver and cable need the keychron-battery kernel module.
panel.title: Keychron mouse

critical_threshold.description: Below this level a second, urgent notification is sent.
critical_threshold.label: Critical threshold (%)

low_threshold.description: At this level the mouse sends a notification and the value in the bar turns red.
low_threshold.label: Notify at (%)

mouse_name.description: Name shown. Leave empty to use the model name from UPower, which can be generic (for example "Keychron Ultra-Link 8K").
mouse_name.label: Mouse name

notify.description: Once per discharge for low and for critical battery.
notify.label: Notifications

poll_interval.description: How often UPower is read. The kernel module itself updates every 5 minutes.
poll_interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
